page.notes: The big initial G is joined to "Ratum" as "GRatum". Long s is written as s throughout. Printed "qv" and "ꝑ" forms were normalised to u (qvoqve, qvod, qvae). "ea" in "affectu ea retulerit" carries a flourish over the a that may be a printed mark, not a letter; read as ea. Catchword "varum" is set at the right below the last line and is kept out of the text.
